exercises.title: Open record and Tweak 'A record opens' are two layouts of one machine
exercises.detail: ListScreen derives split/compact from route child, viewport and the openIn tweak; no single state value exists.
exercises.fix: Keep the derivation in one computed (stacked/split) as now; tests should assert on it.

approvals.title: Approve and Reject have no distinct in-flight state per button
approvals.detail: `acting` disables Reject while Approve loads but a second action can follow a failure with stale doc.
approvals.fix: Clear `doc` and refetch after a failed action.

approvals.title: Selected request can outlive its queue row
approvals.detail: After queue.reload the selected row may no longer exist while the pane stays open.
approvals.fix: Close the pane when the selected row is absent from the refreshed list.

screens-by-role.title: Detail pages decided their screen from a doc ref alone
screens-by-role.detail: PurchaseOrder.vue and OOHBooking.vue showed a skeleton for ever when useDoc failed (no permission, deleted record), because only `!doc` was checked. Fixed: both now have an explicit error state beside loading and loaded.
screens-by-role.fix: Fixed in this change. The pages now branch on error, then loading, then doc.

screens-by-role.title: DataList showed its empty text while loading
screens-by-role.detail: components/DataList.vue rendered 'Nothing here yet' whenever rows was empty, so the Client pages and the Exercise tabs flashed the empty state before data arrived. Fixed: a `loading` prop shows skeleton rows; ClientList.vue and the Exercise tabs pass isFetching.
screens-by-role.fix: Fixed. Reports, CrossBrand, Exercise plan/changes tabs and ClientHome now pass a loading source; Reports and CrossBrand also have an error state. Channels and the Exercise email list read from the loaded doc, so they show the doc skeleton instead.

screens-by-role.title: Client exercise tabs: one failed call looked like an empty tab
screens-by-role.detail: ClientExercise.vue made five calls and handled only the first call's error, so a failed posted_content, out_of_home, results or spend call showed 'Nothing posted yet' and so on.
screens-by-role.fix: Fixed: the active tab's own error shows an ErrorMessage.

screens-by-role.title: Full page reload used as a state transition
screens-by-role.detail: ContentDetail.vue (approve, send for approval) and OOHBooking.vue (advance) called location.reload() after the server call, which throws away list selection and scroll and flashes the whole shell.

screens-by-role.title: Approvals decides its pane from five loose refs
screens-by-role.detail: pages/Approvals.vue: selected, doc, docError, acting and actionError together decide whether the right pane shows nothing, a loading skeleton, an error, the request, or a decided request. They can disagree (docError true while acting). Not fixed here.
screens-by-role.fix: Fixed: one `pane` status (idle, loading, failed, ready, acting) set only in the selection watcher and act(); a stale response for a row no longer selected is dropped.

screens-by-role.title: Booking Approve button shown to people who cannot approve
screens-by-role.detail: OOHBooking.vue offered 'Move to Approved' to every role that opened a booking; the server refuses anyone but the exercise's Brand Manager. Fixed: canAdvance hides the approval step for everyone else.

screens-by-role.title: Placement had no approve or reject
screens-by-role.detail: Placement.vue was read-only, so a Brand Manager could not act on a Pending placement from its record. Fixed: Approve and Reject run the Placement approval workflow for the assigned Brand Manager, and for a Marketing Head, who the workflow lets cover.
screens-by-role.fix: Fixed. Transition names checked against setup_roles_workflows.py: Approve and Reject exist for Placement (assigned approver, and Marketing Head). Not run on a site.

screens-by-role.title: Design vocabulary does not match the Placement doctype
screens-by-role.detail: The canvas shows placement statuses 'Needs scheduling', 'Queued' and 'Not queued'. Placement.status is Scheduled, Posted or Failed, with approval_state Pending, Approved or Rejected. The Vue pages use the doctype's words.
screens-by-role.fix: Redraw the placement boards with the doctype's states, or add the states to the doctype. Decide with the user.
